rows.notes: The cited document is a narrative literature review (titled 'Review'; the abstract and introduction state it reviews literature on precision irrigation monitoring and decision support). It reports no data, experiment, survey or validated model runs of its own; the only original element is a conceptual decision-support framework (Figure 1) described as 'currently being developed'. Statements about soil moisture sensors and sensor placement (Sections 5.1, 7.1) summarise other work and do not report any result of the authors on sensors maintaining optimal soil moisture for fruit development.

Review article with no primary data. Water savings from closed-loop / sensor-based or remotely monitored irrigation (e.g., 20.5% with ANN scheduling, 83% in a nursery, ~20% with the Goumopoulos expert system) are reported from cited studies, not as the authors' own results, and the review itself concludes that demonstrated field-scale water savings are marginal (5-15%). No own evidence on IoT remote monitoring/control reducing water waste.

notes: Document is a complete narrative review (Sustainability 2017, 9, 353); some page-layout text is garbled around p. 21 but content is legible. No primary results exist to support either claim.
